spans.text:
Before any LLM call that *writes* paper content (outline, intro/related work,
section writing, refinement), you MUST prepend the **Anti-Leakage Prompt** at
`references/anti-leakage-prompt.md` to your system prompt. This is verbatim
from Appendix D.4 of the paper and prevents pre-training-data leakage.
spans.note: The prompt includes multiple mechanisms to ensure information integrity: an anti-leakage prompt to prevent pre-training data leakage, a claim-evidence gate that verifies numeric claims in the draft are grounded in the experimental log, provenance tracking with file hashes, and cross-validation of consistency between inputs. These measures collectively enforce truthfulness and information provenance.
